mapper.select: SELECT o.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, o.order_no AS orderNo, s.name AS supplierName, p.name AS productName, d.quantity AS quantity, d.received_quantity AS receivedQuantity, d.cost_price AS costPrice, d.quantity * d.cost_price AS subtotal FROM purchase_order_detail d JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id = d.order_id LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s.id = o.supplier_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = d.product_id WHERE ORDER BY o.purchase_date DESC, o.id DESC, d.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order_detail d JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id = d.order_id WHERE
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(d.quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(d.quantity * d.cost_price), 0) AS totalAmount FROM purchase_order_detail d JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id = d.order_id WHERE
